en: A colorized historic postcard view of a large suspension bridge over a river in an urban setting. The foreground shows landscaped gardens, paths, and fountains, while the bridge's ornate towers and approach ramps dominate the center. In the background stand church spires and city buildings. At the top are multilingual captions (Hungarian, German, and French/English) identifying the scene as the Elisabeth Bridge in Budapest and comparing its span to the Niagara Bridge.
